verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service platform with an operations console, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair question. Nothing in the evidence describes AI-driven insights or suggestions from customer data. The docs cover APIs for customers, accounts, cards, payments, KYC and webhooks, and centralized data visibility. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes only make the documentation machine-readable; they are not in-product AI features.
